record.d: Ge'ez manuscript on parchment from Ethiopia's living scribal culture, its quires link-stitched and laced into wooden boards in a structure like early Coptic codices; the psalter is the commonest kind.

v.d: psalms, canticles and Wǝddase Maryam, copied in great numbers for private devotion

items.why: Product: Ethiopian manuscripts are bought from dealers; scribal art and illumination stay in VE.
